## Requirements

1. OAuth provider exchange — GitHub device-flow client (device-code
   request, polling with `slow_down`/`expired` handling, token → subject
   via `GET /user`) feeding the existing `oauth{audience}` mediator leg;
   the access token is held broker-side, never ledgered; hermetic
   local-issuer fixture tests cover success, denial, expiry, slow_down and
   forged tokens → typed 401.
2. mTLS — `serve --http` (or the Lab MCP HTTP surface) optionally behind
   the R4.5c TLS server requiring client certs; the verified peer identity
   maps to a subject through a declared mapping table;
   `transport_absent` refusal remains only where TLS is not configured.
3. Live leg `oauth-device` (operator present) — `scripts/live-verify.sh`
   prints the verification URL + user code to the operator's terminal
   (never to a ledger), polls, resolves the subject, records
   `provided: yes`, the subject-login sha256 and the outcome; mTLS leg
   over the local test CA recorded fixture-verified (local CA by ruling).
4. DF-S4.11-2 → DONE; ADR-0303/0351 trigger notes; BL-27 evidence for
   R4.16.

## Plan

Design (vs ADR-0365 D3's closed `hh-tls` consumer set — `hh-gateway`,
`hh-env`, `hh-embed` only): `hh-mcp-lab` consumes the TLS surface
through `hh_embed::service` re-exports — the ADR-0351 D5
`MintedVerdict` precedent verbatim (a surface speaks the type without a
direct edge; removability preserved — surfaces reach the kernel
boundary only). No new dependency edge, no sibling ADR needed.

1. `hh-embed/src/service.rs` — re-export `hh_tls::{ClientTls, TlsStream,
   ServerTls, ServerTlsStream, PeerIdentity, TlsError}` beside the
   `MintedVerdict` re-export.
2. `hh-tls/src/server.rs` — `ServerTlsStream::set_nonblocking` for the
   multiplex arm.
3. `hh-mcp-lab/src/oauth.rs` (new) — the provider exchange: `Io`
   (`Read+Write`) seam, `Transport::{Tls,Loopback}` `open` (loopback
   refuses non-loopback hosts), `DeviceFlow{device_code_url,token_url,
   user_url}` + `github()`, `initiate` (device-code POST), `poll_once`
   (`authorization_pending|slow_down|expired_token|access_denied|
   incorrect_device_code`), `poll_until` (deadline+interval, injected
   sleep), `verify_bearer`/`fetch_subject` (GET /user → `login`; 401 →
   typed `Invalid`). Token stays inside the exchange — only the subject
   returns; never ledgered (broker-side custody = confined to the
   exchange scope, no record names it).
4. `binding.rs` — `CredentialRefusal::IssuerUnreachable`
   (`issuer_unreachable` — additive, CC8): the declared issuer's
   exchange could not be reached — transient, distinct from
   `transport_absent` (no exchange exists).
5. `server.rs` — `oauth_issuers: BTreeMap<issuer_ref, OAuthIssuer>`
   (declared issuer table — an undeclared `issuer_ref` keeps the landed
   kernel `minted_scoped` leg); `mtls_subjects: BTreeMap<subject,
   CallerBinding>` (the declared mapping table — CN then SAN-URI then
   SAN-DNS keys); `grant_mtls_subject`; `resolve_mtls_peer`
   (`PeerIdentity` → binding; unmapped → `no_grant`; non-mtls binding
   under the map → `credential_invalid`); `resolve_credential` oauth leg
   consults `oauth_issuers` first — provider `verify_bearer` 2xx →
   resolve, 401/403 → `credential_invalid`, unreachable →
   `issuer_unreachable`; `mtls` via bearer still `transport_absent`.
6. `http.rs` — `Conn` generic over `S: Read+Write` + a resolved-binding
   slot; `serve_http_mtls(srv, listener, origins, &ServerTls)`: accept →
   blocking handshake (bounded rw deadlines) → `peer_identity` →
   `resolve_mtls_peer` (refused → the 401 challenge over the TLS stream,
   handshake-refused → close, never a guessed subject) → multiplex the
   TLS stream exactly like the plain arm (the handshake's identity is
   the credential — no bearer consulted).
7. `tests/r4_7a.rs` — hermetic battery (fixture issuer on loopback +
   the committed test PKI).
8. `tests/r4_7a_live.rs` — gated cells `initiate`/`complete` for the
   resumable `oauth-device` leg (state under gitignored
   `docs/build/logs/`).
9. `scripts/live-oauth-device.sh` + `live-verify.sh` registry —
   `oauth-device` leg (`github.com:443`/`api.github.com:443`;
   `HH_GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` names-only; user_code prints to the
   operator's terminal/gitignored file, never a transcript/ledger).
10. Docs: DF-S4.11-2 dated note (DONE only on completed exchange);
    `docs/build/reports/<date>-adr-0303-0351-trigger.md` re-homed
    trigger notes (landed ADRs frozen — 0b3ca91 precedent); BL-27 /
    R-2.11.3 evidence recorded for R4.16.

≈1,992 changed lines vs 800 (≈2.5×) — **accepted as recorded Deviation**: atomic mediator scope (oauth issuer leg + mtls peer-subject resolution + the serve_http_mtls surface + refusal legs + resumable leg machinery); green under real verification.
